name: larpbox-tv
description: Larpbox TV: a shared-screen party game about professional exaggeration.

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @larpbox/shared && concurrently -k -n shared,server,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @larpbox/shared" "npm run dev -w @larpbox/server" "npm run dev -w @larpbox/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @larpbox/shared && npm run build -w @larpbox/web && npm run build -w @larpbox/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @larpbox/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json
